answer.answer: For the period ending 2007-09-29, ST-EVA holds two revenue observations for Apple (AAPL), both sourced from SEC filings via the SecEdgar provider. The first observation (obsarch_ddb4af888ab3c6be910c0f9e) comes from filing accession 0001193125-09-214859 (a 10-K) and reports revenue of $24,006,000,000. The second observation (obsarch_6383b6a9892d72ff26aab02a) comes from filing accession 0001193125-10-012091 (a 10-K/A) and reports revenue of $24,578,000,000. Both observations reference the same source document, which has the content hash sha256:8b37365a7f187479d40d872ed51551ca40a3981268248b91ba2643cbfb152591. The two filings report different values for the same concept (us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet) and period; ST-EVA has not selected a winner and flags this as an ambiguity due to multiple filings.
uncertainties: Which of the two filings (original 10-K or amended 10-K/A) represents the authoritative revenue figure for the period is not settled by the evidence. The two values differ by $572 million.
